title: Scheduled Amazon EventBridge rule for AWS Lambda
description: Create an scheduled EventBridge rule that invokes a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK pattern deploys a custom scheduled EventBridge rule that triggers a Lambda function. An environment variable contains the value assigned to the interval (in minutes) that the Lambda function will run.

bullets.text: Reducing custom code by using advanced rules in Amazon EventBridge
Use Amazon EventBridge to Build Decoupled, Event-Driven Architectures

testing.headline: Testing
text: After waiting for the interval period, go to the Lambda console.
Find the deployed Lambda function, and open the CloudWatch Logs. You will see a new log event every minute.
